capabilities: Navigate to any daily note from a calendar view
Create missing daily notes using the daily note template
Show per-day word-count dots and incomplete-task indicators
Open weekly notes via week-number cells or commands
Customize appearance with CSS variables and class overrides
disambiguation: Not a scheduling or event calendar; it only visualizes and navigates daily notes by date.
extras: Weekly notes within this plugin are deprecated; the author recommends switching to the Periodic Notes plugin, which migrates settings automatically. Requires Obsidian v0.9.11 or above.
intentEvidence: The plugin reads your Daily Note settings to know your date format, your daily note template location
problem: Obsidian's daily notes give no visual, date-based way to see which days have notes, jump between them, or backfill missing days.

relations.evidence: The weekly note functionality has been split out into its very own plugin.
especially if you have the Sliding Panes plugin enabled!

summary: Sidebar calendar view for navigating, creating, and visualizing daily notes, with word-count dots and optional weekly notes.
